Coordinated Batch Processing协调式批处理

— PDF 第 165 页 —

Chapter 12 described a number of patterns for splitting and chaining queues together to achieve more complex batch processing. Duplicating and producing multiple different outputs is often an important part of batch processing, but sometimes it is equally important to pull multiple outputs back together in order to generate some sort of aggregate output. A generic illustration of such a pattern is shown in Figure 13-1.

第 12 章介绍了若干把队列拆分、串联起来以实现更复杂批处理的模式。复制并产生多个不同输出，通常是批处理的重要一环；但有时，把多个输出重新汇集到一起、以生成某种聚合输出，同样重要。图 13-1 给出了这类模式的一个通用示意。

— PDF 第 166 页 —

Probably the most canonical example of this aggregation is the reduce part of the MapReduce pattern. It’s easy to see that the map step is an example of sharding a work queue, and the reduce step is an example of coordinated processing that eventually reduces a large number of outputs down to a single aggregate response. However, there are a number of different aggregate patterns for batch processing, and this chapter discusses a number of them in addition to real-world applications.

这种聚合最经典的例子，大概就是 MapReduce 模式中的 reduce（归约）部分。不难看出：map 步骤是对工作队列进行分片的一个例子，而 reduce 步骤则是协调式处理的一个例子——它最终把大量输出归约为单一的聚合结果。不过，批处理还有许多不同的聚合模式，本章除了介绍实际应用之外，也会讨论其中若干种。

Join (or Barrier Synchronization)Join（或称屏障同步）

In previous chapters, we saw patterns for breaking up work and distributing it in parallel on multiple nodes. In particular, we saw how a sharded work queue could distribute work in parallel to a number of different work queue shards. However, sometimes when processing a workflow, it is necessary to have the complete set of work available to you before you move on to the next stage of the workflow.

在前面几章中，我们见过把工作拆开、并行分发到多个节点上的各种模式。尤其是，我们看到了分片工作队列如何把工作并行分发到若干不同的工作队列分片。然而，有时在处理一个工作流时，你必须先拿到完整的全部工作，才能进入工作流的下一阶段。

One option for doing this was shown in Chapter 12, which was to merge multiple queues together. However, merge simply blends the output of two work queues into a single work queue for additional processing. While the merge pattern is sufficient in some cases, it does not ensure that a complete data set is present prior to the beginning of processing. This means that there can be no guarantees about the completeness of the processing being performed, as well as no opportunity to compute aggregate statistics for all of the elements that have been processed.

实现这一点的一种做法已在第 12 章给出，即把多个队列合并（merge）到一起。但 merge 只是把两个工作队列的输出糅合进同一个工作队列，以供后续处理。虽然 merge 模式在某些情况下够用，但它并不保证在处理开始前数据集是完整的。这意味着：既无法保证所执行处理的完整性，也没有机会对所有已处理元素计算聚合统计。

To give a concrete example of the necessity of the join pattern, consider the creation of a digitally animated film. Each frame of the film is an independent work item; it can be rendered in parallel without reference to any of the other frames in the movie. However, consider transforming each frame of the movie into one second of video. You clearly need to have all thirty frames that make up that one second present before they are transformed into video.

举一个具体例子来说明 join 模式的必要性：想象一部数字动画电影的制作。影片的每一帧都是一个独立的工作项；它可以在不参考影片中任何其他帧的情况下被并行渲染。但是，当你要把电影的每一帧转换成一秒钟的视频时，情况就不同了——你显然必须先集齐组成那一秒钟的全部三十帧，才能把它们转成视频。

We need a stronger, coordinated primitive for batch data processing, and that primitive is the join pattern. Join is similar to joining a thread. The basic idea is that all of the work is happening in parallel, but work items aren’t released out of the join until all of the work items that are processed in parallel are completed. This is also generally known as barrier synchronization in concurrent programming. An illustration of the join pattern for a coordinated batch is shown in Figure 13-2.

我们需要一个更强、更具协调性的批数据处理原语，那就是 join 模式。Join 类似于线程的 join（等待线程结束）。其基本思想是：所有工作都在并行进行，但在 join 之外，工作项不会被释放——直到所有并行处理的工作项全部完成为止。这在并发编程中通常也称为屏障同步（barrier synchronization）。图 13-2 给出了协调式批处理中 join 模式的示意。

— PDF 第 167 页 —

Coordination through join ensures that no data is missing before some sort of aggregation phase is performed (e.g., finding the sum of some value in a set). The value of the join is that it ensures that all of the data in the set is present. The downside of the join pattern is that it requires that all data be processed by a previous stage before subsequent computation can begin. This reduces the parallelism that is possible in the batch workflow, and thus increases the overall latency of running the workflow, as discussed in Chapter 12. This latency increase can be compensated for by trading compute for time and duplicating the processing of all of the work items to reduce the impact of tail latency.

通过 join 进行协调，可以确保在执行某种聚合阶段（例如求集合中某个值的总和）之前不缺任何数据。Join 的价值就在于它保证集合中所有数据都已就位。Join 模式的缺点在于：它要求上一阶段先把所有数据处理完，后续计算才能开始。这降低了批处理工作流中可能达到的并行度，从而如第 12 章所述，增加了运行该工作流的整体延迟。这种延迟的增加，可以通过用算力换时间、并对所有工作项做重复处理来补偿，以降低尾延迟的影响。

Reduce归约（Reduce）

If sharding a work queue is an example of the map phase of the canonical MapReduce algorithm, then what remains is the reduce phase. Reduce is an example of a coordinated batch processing pattern because it can happen regardless of how the input is split up, and it is used similar to join; that is, to group together the parallel output of a number of different batch operations on different pieces of data.

如果说对工作队列分片是经典 MapReduce 算法中 map 阶段的一个例子，那么剩下的就是 reduce 阶段。Reduce 是一种协调式批处理模式的例子，因为无论输入如何切分它都能进行，而且它的用法与 join 类似：把作用于不同数据分片上的多个不同批处理操作所产生的并行输出汇集到一起。

However, in contrast to the join pattern described previously, the goal of reduce is not to wait until all data has been processed, but rather to optimistically merge together all of the parallel data items into a single comprehensive representation of the full set. With the reduce pattern, each step in the reduce merges several different outputs into a single output. This stage is called “reduce” because it reduces the total number of outputs. Additionally, it reduces the data from a complete data item to simply the representative data necessary for producing the answer to a specific batch computation. Because the reduce phase operates on a range of input and produces a similar output, the reduce phase can be repeated as many or as few times as necessary in order to successfully reduce the output down to a single output for the entire data set.

然而，与前面描述的 join 模式不同，reduce 的目标并不是等到所有数据都被处理完，而是乐观地把所有并行数据项合并成一份对整个数据集的完整表示。在 reduce 模式中，reduce 的每一步都把若干不同输出合并为一个输出。这个阶段之所以称为“reduce（归约）”，是因为它减少了输出的总数。此外，它还把数据从一个完整的数据项，缩减为仅仅是得出某次批计算答案所必需的代表性数据。由于 reduce 阶段作用于一定范围的输入并产生与之类似的输出，因此它可以根据需要重复任意多次，直到成功地把整个数据集的输出归约为单一输出为止。

— PDF 第 168 页 —

This is a fortunate contrast to the join pattern, because unlike join, it means that reduce can be started in parallel while there is still processing going on as part of the map/shard phase. Of course, in order to produce a complete output, all of the data must be processed eventually, but the ability to begin early means that the batch computation executes more quickly overall.

这一点与 join 模式形成了可喜的对比：与 join 不同，它意味着 reduce 可以在 map/分片阶段仍在进行处理时就并行启动。当然，为了产生完整的输出，所有数据最终都必须被处理；但能够提前开始这一点，意味着整个批计算执行得更快。

Hands On: Count动手实践：计数

To understand how the reduce pattern works, consider the task of counting the number of instances of a particular word in a book. We can first use sharding to divide up the work of counting words into a number of different work queues. As an example, we could create 10 different sharded work queues with 10 different people responsible for counting words in each queue. We can shard the book among these 10 work queues by looking at the page number. All pages that end in the number 1 will go to the first queue, all pages that end in the number 2 will go to the second, and so forth.

为理解 reduce 模式如何工作，考虑这样一个任务：统计一本书中某个特定单词出现的次数。我们可以先用分片把统计单词的工作划分到若干不同的工作队列。举例来说，我们可以创建 10 个不同的分片工作队列，由 10 个不同的人分别负责统计各自队列中的单词。我们可以按页码把这本书分片到这 10 个工作队列：所有以数字 1 结尾的页进第一个队列，以数字 2 结尾的页进第二个队列，依此类推。

Once all of the people have finished processing their pages, they write down their results on a piece of paper. For example, they might write:

当所有人都处理完各自的页面后，他们把结果写在一张纸上。例如，他们可能写下：

a: 50
the: 17
cat: 2
airplane: 1
...

This can be output to the reduce phase. Remember that the reduce pattern reduces by combining two or more outputs into a single output.

这些结果可以输出到 reduce 阶段。记住，reduce 模式是通过把两个或多个输出合并为一个输出来进行归约的。

Given a second output:

假设有第二份输出：

a: 30
the: 25
dog: 4
airplane: 2
...

The reduction proceeds by summing up all of the counts for the various words, in this example producing:

归约时，把各个单词的计数相加，在本例中产生：

a: 80
the 42
dog: 4
cat: 2
airplane: 3
...
— PDF 第 169 页 —

It’s clear to see that this reduction phase can be repeated on the output of previous reduce phases until there is only a single reduced output left. This is valuable since this means that reductions can be performed in parallel.

显而易见，这个归约阶段可以反复作用于上一轮 reduce 的输出，直到只剩一个归约后的输出。这很有价值，因为它意味着各轮归约可以并行进行。

Ultimately, in this example you can see that the output of the reduction will be a single output with the count of all of the various words that are present in the book. Of course, the number of times reduce is run has an impact on the overall performance of the batch processing. Too many reduce operations cause significant wasted computation, while too few begin to resemble the synchronization of the join pattern.

最终，在本例中你会看到：归约的输出将是单一输出，其中包含书中出现的所有不同单词的计数。当然，reduce 运行的次数会影响批处理的整体性能：reduce 操作太多会造成大量浪费的计算，太少则又开始变得像 join 模式那样的同步。

Sum求和

A similar but slightly different form of reduction is the summation of a collection of different values. This is like counting, but rather than simply counting one for every value, you actually add together a value that is present in the original output data. Suppose, for example, you want to sum the total population of the United States. Assume that you will do this by measuring the population in every town and then summing them all together.

一种类似但略有不同的归约形式，是对一组不同的值求和。它类似于计数，但不是对每个值简单地数 1，而是把原始输出数据中存在的某个实际值加起来。举例来说，假设你想求出美国的总人口。假定你将通过测量每个城镇的人口、然后把它们全部加在一起来完成。

A first step might be to shard the work into work queues of towns, sharded by state. This is a great first sharding, but it’s clear that even when distributed in parallel, it would take a single person a long time to count the number of people in every town. Consequently, we perform a second sharding to another set of work queues, this time by county.

第一步或许是把工作按州分片到各个城镇工作队列。这是一个很好的初次分片，但显然，即使并行分发，一个人要数清每个城镇的人数也要花很长时间。于是，我们再做第二次分片，分到另一组工作队列，这次按县（county）分片。

At this point, we have parallelized first to the level of states, then to the level of counties, and then each work queue in each county produces a stream of outputs of (town, population) tuples.

至此，我们先并行化到州这一层，再到县这一层，然后每个县里的每个工作队列都会产生一串由（城镇，人口）二元组构成的输出流。

Now that we are producing output, the reduce pattern can kick in.

既然开始产生输出了，reduce 模式就可以登场了。

In this case, the reduce doesn’t even really need to be aware of the two-level sharding that we performed. It is sufficient for the reduce to simply grab two or more output items, such as (Seattle, 4,000,000) and (Northampton, 25,000), and sum them together to produce a new output (Seattle-Northampton, 4,025,000). It’s clear to see that, like counting, this reduction can be performed an arbitrary number of times with the same code running at each interval, and at the end, there will only be a single output containing the complete population of the United States. Importantly, again, nearly all of the computation required is happening in parallel.

在本例中，reduce 甚至根本不需要知道我们做过的两级分片。Reduce 只要随手抓取两个或多个输出项——例如（Seattle，4,000,000）和（Northampton，25,000）——把它们相加，产生新的输出（Seattle-Northampton，4,025,000）即可。显而易见，与计数一样，这种归约可以用同一份代码在每一层重复任意多次，最终只会剩下一个输出，其中包含美国的完整人口。同样重要的是，几乎所有所需计算都是并行发生的。

— PDF 第 170 页 —

Histogram直方图

As a final example of the reduce pattern, consider that while we are counting the population of the United States via parallel sharding/mapping and reducing, we also want to build a model of the average American family. To do this, we want to develop a histogram of family size; that is, a model that estimates the total number of families with zero to 10 children. We will perform our multilevel sharding exactly as before (indeed, we can likely use the same workers).

作为 reduce 模式的最后一个例子，设想我们在通过并行分片/映射与归约统计美国人口的同时，还想建立一个关于美国家庭平均情况的模型。为此，我们要构建一个家庭规模的直方图；也就是一个估计“有 0 到 10 个孩子的家庭总数”的模型。我们将完全像之前那样执行多级分片（实际上很可能可以复用同一批 worker）。

However, this time, the output of the data collection phase is a histogram per town:

不过这一次，数据收集阶段的输出是每个城镇一个直方图：

0: 15%
1: 25%
2: 45%
3: 10%
4: 5%

From the previous examples, we can see that if we apply the reduce pattern, we should be able to combine all of these histograms to develop a comprehensive picture of the United States. At first blush, it may seem quite difficult to understand how to merge these histograms, but when combined with the population data from the summation example, we can see that if we multiply each histogram by its relative population, then we can obtain the total population for each item being merged. If we then divide this new total by the sum of the merged populations, it is clear that we can merge and update multiple different histograms into a single output. Given this, we can apply the reduce pattern as many times as necessary until a single output is produced.

从前面的例子可以看出：如果应用 reduce 模式，我们应该能够把所有这些直方图合并起来，形成一幅关于美国的完整图景。乍一看，要弄明白如何合并这些直方图似乎相当困难；但当把它与求和例子中的人口数据结合起来时，我们就会发现：如果把每个直方图乘以它相应的人口，就能得到每个被合并项的总人口。然后再把这个新总数除以被合并人口之和，显然就能把多个不同的直方图合并、更新为单一输出。据此，我们可以根据需要多次应用 reduce 模式，直到产生单一输出。

Hands On: An Image Tagging and Processing Pipeline动手实践：图像标注与处理流水线

To see how coordinated batch processing can be used to accomplish a larger batch task, consider the job of tagging and processing a set of images. Let us assume that we have a large collection of images of highways at rush hour, and we want to count both the numbers of cars, trucks, and motorcycles, as well as distribution of the colors of each of the vehicles. Let us also suppose that there is a preliminary step to blur the license plates of all of the vehicles to preserve anonymity.

为了看清协调式批处理如何用来完成更大的批任务，考虑这样一项工作：对一组图像进行标注与处理。假设我们有大量高峰时段高速公路的图片，既想统计汽车、卡车、摩托车的数量，又想统计各种车辆颜色的分布。我们还假设有一个前置步骤：模糊所有车辆的车牌，以保护隐私。

The images are delivered to us as a series of HTTPS URLs where each URL points to a raw image. The first stage in the pipeline is to find and blur the license plates. To simplify each task in the work queue, we will have one worker that detects a license plate, and a second worker that blurs that location in the image. We will combine these two different worker containers into a single container group using the multiworker pattern described in Chapter 12.

这些图像以一系列 HTTPS URL 的形式交付给我们，每个 URL 指向一张原始图像。流水线的第一阶段是找到并模糊车牌。为了简化工作队列中的每个任务，我们安排一个 worker 检测车牌，再安排第二个 worker 模糊图像中的那个位置。我们将使用第 12 章所述的多 worker 模式，把这两个不同的 worker 容器组合成一个容器组。

— PDF 第 171 页 —

This separation of concerns may seem unnecessary, but it facilitates container image reuse. Imagine if the API to our container is an image and a box to blur. The same container that blurs license plates can be reused to blur people’s faces in a different pipeline.

这种关注点分离看似多余，但它便于容器镜像的复用。设想我们这个容器的 API 是“一张图像 + 一个要模糊的方框”，那么这个模糊车牌的同一个容器，就可以在另一条流水线中复用来模糊人脸。

Additionally, to ensure reliability and to maximize parallel processing, we will shard the images across multiple worker queues. This complete workflow for sharded image blurring is shown in Figure 13-3.

此外，为确保可靠性并最大化并行处理，我们会把图像分片到多个 worker 队列。这个分片图像模糊处理的完整工作流如图 13-3 所示。

Once each image has been successfully blurred, we will upload it to a different location, and we will then delete the originals. However, we don’t want to delete the original until all of the images have been successfully blurred in case there is some sort of catastrophic failure and we need to rerun this entire pipeline. Thus, to wait for all of the blurring to complete, we use the join pattern to merge the output of all of the sharded blurring work queues into a single queue that will only release its items after all of the shards have completed the work.

每张图像成功模糊后，我们会把它上传到另一个位置，然后删除原图。不过，在所有图像都成功模糊之前，我们不想删除原图——以防发生某种灾难性故障、需要重新运行整条流水线。因此，为等待所有模糊处理完成，我们使用 join 模式，把所有分片模糊工作队列的输出合并到一个单一队列；该队列只有在所有分片都完成工作后才会释放其中的项。

Now we are ready to delete the original images as well as begin work on vehicle model and color detection. Again, we want to maximize the throughput of this pipeline, so we will use the copier pattern from Chapter 12 to duplicate the work queue items to two different queues:

现在我们既可以删除原图，也可以开始进行车辆型号与颜色检测。同样，我们希望最大化这条流水线的吞吐量，因此会使用第 12 章的 copier（复制器）模式，把工作队列项复制到两个不同的队列：

  • A work queue that deletes the original images一个删除原始图像的工作队列
  • A work queue that identifies the type of vehicle (car, truck, motorcycle) and the color of the vehicle一个识别车辆类型（汽车、卡车、摩托车）以及车辆颜色的工作队列
— PDF 第 172 页 —

Figure 13-4 shows these stages of the processing pipeline.

图 13-4 展示了处理流水线的这些阶段。

Finally, we need to design the queue that identifies vehicles and colors and aggregates these statistics into a final count. To do this, we first again apply the shard pattern to distribute the work out to a number of queues. Each of these queues has two different workers: one that identifies the location and type of each vehicle and one that identifies the color of a region.

最后，我们需要设计那个识别车辆与颜色、并把这些统计量聚合成最终计数的队列。为此，我们首先再次应用分片模式，把工作分发到若干队列。每个这样的队列有两个不同的 worker：一个识别每辆车的位置和类型，另一个识别某个区域的颜色。

We will again join these together using the multiworker pattern described in Chapter 12. As before, the separation of code into different containers enables us to reuse the color detection container for multiple tasks beyond identifying the color of the vehicles.

我们将再次使用第 12 章所述的多 worker 模式把它们 join 到一起。如前所述，把代码拆分到不同容器，使我们能够把颜色检测容器复用于多种任务，而不仅仅是识别车辆颜色。

The output of this work queue is a JSON tuple that looks like this:

这个工作队列的输出是一个形如如下的 JSON 元组：

{
  "vehicles": {
    "car": 12,
    "truck": 7,
    "motorcycle": 4
  },
  "colors": {
    "white": 8,
    "black": 3,
    "blue": 6,
    "red": 6
  }
}
— PDF 第 173 页 —

This data represents the information found in a single image. To aggregate all of this data together, we will use the reduce pattern described previously and made famous by MapReduce to sum everything together just as we did in the count example above. At the end, this reduce pipeline stage produces the final count of images and colors found in the complete set of images.

这份数据表示在单张图像中发现的信息。为把所有这些数据聚合到一起，我们将使用前面描述的、因 MapReduce 而闻名的 reduce 模式，把所有内容相加——就像上面计数例子中所做的那样。最终，这个 reduce 流水线阶段会产生在整组图像中发现的图像与颜色的最终计数。

Summary小结

This chapter describes coordinated batch processing, which is used to synchronize workflows for preconditions or to combine output from previous workflows into a merged output. The join pattern is used as a barrier synchronizer to ensure that all of the necessary output is ready before proceeding to the next stage. Reduce combines output from multiple shards into an output that can be reduced further until the final output is ready. Sum and histogram are specific types of reduce operations that are useful for obtaining specific statistical results from your data. Taken together, these patterns for coordination in batch processing can ensure that you can build the workflow that is necessary for any batch operation or calculation you need to perform.

本章介绍了协调式批处理，它用于同步工作流的前置条件，或把前序工作流的输出合并为一个合并后的输出。Join 模式充当屏障同步器，确保在进入下一阶段前所有必要输出都已就绪。Reduce 把来自多个分片的输出合并为一个输出，该输出还可进一步归约，直到最终输出就绪。求和与直方图是两种特定类型的 reduce 操作，可用于从数据中获得特定的统计结果。总而言之，这些批处理协调模式能够确保你为任何需要执行的批操作或计算，构建出所需的工作流。
